sections.heading: Overview
bullets: A big single-target burn split by two invulnerable orb-catching phases and a core-exposure damage window. 10-minute enrage.

sections.heading: Orb phases (66% / 33%) — Magic Blast
bullets: Keep Construct goes invulnerable and channels <mark>Magic Blast</mark> — everyone gets a red or white marker, and matching colored energy balls move toward the boss.
Block the balls matching your own marker — spread by color and stay in your section rather than crossing the arena to help another color.
Every ball that connects stacks Magic Blast Intensity, which scales the eventual explosion — 15+ stacks gets dangerous, 20+ risks a wipe, so don't let them slip through.

sections.heading: Breakbar & core phase
bullets: Kill the Projections near the boss to strip 2 stacks of vulnerability, which opens his defiance bar — break it fast to trigger the Exposed Core Phase.
Three green circles spawn needing at least 2 players each.

A pink Construct Core appears with 5 Ley Rifts around the arena edge — a designated player (usually support) pushes the core through rifts. Each rift it passes through stacks a debuff for the next burn phase, worth +75% incoming damage per stack — aim for 3-5 rifts depending on squad damage.

sections.heading: Other attacks to know
bullets: <mark>Xera's Fury</mark>: the red circle attack — heavy damage if it's allowed to fill, so spread and don't overlap.

<mark>Hail of Fury</mark>: he leaps and drops debris, stunning anyone hit for 1 second. <mark>Tower Drop</mark> is similar — a leap that knocks down on landing. Both are worth dodging rather than tanking through.
<mark>Construct Aura</mark> pulses passive damage to the whole arena the entire fight — nothing to react to, just don't ignore it as free incoming damage.
Large waves of Phantasms spawn with red/white markers matching player markers — only damage the ones matching your color. Failing to clear them in time triggers a squad-wide attack.

sections.heading: Enrage
bullets: 10:00 — Keep Construct deals +200% damage past this point.
